title: The Eventin – Events Calendar, Tickets, Registration, Booking & WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to…
description: The Eventin WordPress plugin (up to version 4.1.29) has a vulnerability that allows authenticated users with subscriber-level access or higher to access sensitive information. By manipulating the 'id' parameter in a query string, an attacker can retrieve email addresses and phone numbers of any WordPress user, including administrators.
